title: Remove standing-only policy strength amplification during active shell locomotion

observed_failure.strength_inheritance: ResolveCausalStandingPolicyStrengthFactor returns 1.5 for both BalanceActive_Standing and LocomotionActiveShell. The 1.5 factor was established by standing experiments before LocomotionActiveShell existed and has not been causally validated for moving references.

hypothesis: Retaining the proven 1.5 strength only in BalanceActive_Standing while using identity strength 1.0 in LocomotionActiveShell will reduce action-driven moving tilt without suppressing policy actions or changing Pose Search, shell motion, target composition, or standing behavior.
single_behavior_change: ResolveCausalStandingPolicyStrengthFactor returns 1.5 only for BalanceActive_Standing after the first active policy capture. LocomotionActiveShell returns 1.0. All other states and passive/ZeroActions modes remain unchanged.
tdd_contract: Captured nonzero policy in BalanceActive_Standing still resolves 1.5.
Captured nonzero policy in LocomotionActiveShell resolves 1.0.
Before first active policy capture, both states resolve 1.0.
Standing production bundle focused regressions remain green.
Scripted path remains 180-260 cm, yaw remains 30 degrees, Pose Search remains non-idle, control gain readback remains 21/21, and stop returns to standing.
next_if_supported: Run Normal and ZeroActions and evaluate the locked AUC ratio. If it passes, create protocol v2 and run the complete deterministic causal/control bundle.
